title: Mysterium Magnum (Vol. 2)
author: Jacob Böhme
description: The second volume continues Böhme’s mystical reading of Genesis from chapter XLIV, following the patriarchal narratives in John Sparrow’s English translation.
editionNote: 1924 edition. London: John M. Watkins. Edition credit: John Sparrow.
